details.title: NGSI-LD alarms
details.description: The alarms at a broker c³ knows - the entities of a type (a corCep rule's create, say), newest first, by severity - read through c³; acknowledged or deleted too

preference.name: broker
preference.label: Broker
preference.description: The broker's URL, as c³ knows it (picked in the widget)

preference.name: tenant
preference.label: Tenant
preference.description: The tenant the alarms are in

preference.name: type
preference.label: Alarm type
preference.description: The entity type of the alarms

preference.name: text
preference.label: Text
preference.description: The attribute shown - empty: message, description or name, else the first text

preference.name: severity
preference.label: Severity
preference.description: The attribute giving the colour: critical, high, error / warning, medium / low, info

preference.name: refresh
preference.label: Refresh
preference.description: Read again every so many seconds (0: never)
